module.name: axm-invariant-lab
module.purpose: Bounded state-space exploration, cross-implementation checking, tractability measurement, read-only donor refinement including runtime-observation, held-out closure, unlabeled multi-project trace closure, and cross-version opaque recovery evidence, plus cross-repository counterexample packet consumption with explicit external-consumer continuity.

capabilities.description: Explore a finite, explicitly declared transition model breadth-first to find shortest invariant counterexamples or preserve unknown observations as HOLD.

evidence.boundary: second implementation shares the authored model transition and invariant functions; model fidelity is not independently proven

capabilities.description: Cross-check the primary visited-state explorer with an independent bounded path enumerator and fail closed when the reference enumeration budget is incomplete.
Measure deterministic work-count boundaries between the visited-state explorer and independent all-path verifier on a bounded reconverging fixture, preserving budget exhaustion as HOLD.

evidence.boundary: synthetic reconverging model only; no wall-clock, arbitrary-model, solver, donor-runtime, or real-world performance claim

capabilities.description: Read-only refinement of AXM Monolith Pipeline Fabric v0.1 candidate-only and explicit no-automatic-authority fields against a pinned donor contract fixture.

evidence.boundary: separately authored adapter over an exact pinned donor contract fixture; no full-stack Monolith runtime export is claimed

capabilities.description: Read-only refinement of a pinned AXM State Research Workfloor Sentinel execution-results artifact, deriving necessary-minus-awakened misses and comparing the known dependency-bug step with the repaired step without reimplementing donor checks.

evidence.boundary: mechanical projection of explicit donor-emitted fields from one Workfloor Sentinel results artifact; donor oracle defines necessity and Invariant Lab does not execute or independently reconstruct Sentinel semantics

capabilities.description: Read-only refinement of pinned AXM State Research Wakeup Fuzzer execution evidence that derives one omitted required wake from runtime-observed activation, actual output change, and sparse mismatch without consuming donor necessary/missed oracle fields, then checks four repaired transitions across full-scan, sparse, and observed-read records.

evidence.boundary: one minimized broken trace plus four repaired transitions; runtime-observed reads are donor instrumentation and are not claimed complete for unseen branches, dynamic/external reads, or concurrency

capabilities.description: Read-only refinement of a pinned real-project held-out closure trial that falsifies closure-completeness for observed-only runtime-read evidence using a one-mutation minimized conditional-read counterexample, with declared-risk audit as a separate detection control on the same frozen manifest.

evidence.boundary: donor offline oracle scores hidden staleness/final equality; Invariant Lab does not execute Sentinel, independently derive the oracle, or claim declared-risk auditing universally sufficient

capabilities.description: Read-only refinement of a pinned unlabeled two-project State Research closure challenge that rejects final equality as sufficient when transient silent-stale outputs occurred and requires fail-closed provenance-preserving recovery for absent or corrupt checkpoints.

evidence.boundary: the donor offline oracle still scores hidden staleness/equality; Invariant Lab checks exact pinned outcome and checkpoint receipts only, does not execute donor projects, and does not claim the selected combined policy generally sufficient

capabilities.description: Read-only refinement of a pinned State Research opaque-evaluator version challenge: evaluator-source identity drift invalidates stale checkpoint reuse; changed available source is bounded by re-execution, while unavailable source preserves affected outputs as explicit unresolved/escalated state.

evidence.boundary: synthetic two-version donor challenge; donor offline oracle still scores correctness, Invariant Lab does not execute opaque evaluators or infer hidden dependencies, and source-hash identity is not claimed generally sufficient for semantic equivalence

capabilities.description: Emit bounded machine-readable FAIL/HOLD evidence without granting donor, execution, merge, promotion, or CANON authority.

evidence.boundary: AXM Monolith and AXM Profession Mesh both consume the exact v0.1 FAIL/HOLD result contract without replacing its status meaning; this does not promote model fidelity or real-environment evidence

capabilities.description: Track exact producer packet/schema blobs pinned by distinct external AXM consumers and fail closed when local producer bytes drift until compatibility is deliberately reviewed.

evidence.boundary: local compatibility guard attests producer byte identity and distinct registered repositories only; it does not remotely execute consumers or prove they are deployed

truth_boundary: A PASS means no counterexample was found only inside the exact declared model, predicates, transitions, bound, or explicit donor fields actually inspected. Cross-implementation agreement checks exploration semantics over shared authored model functions; tractability evidence is a deterministic synthetic work-count boundary, not a general performance claim. Monolith refinement is contract-fixture evidence. Workfloor Sentinel refinement accepts donor oracle necessity fields; Wakeup Fuzzer refinement derives one omitted wake without those fields from donor runtime-observed activation, change, and mismatch records. The held-out closure refinement records a direct ceiling on that evidence: observed-only runtime-read closure has a pinned one-mutation counterexample on a training-unexposed conditional dependency. The unlabeled multi-project refinement adds a distinct boundary: observed-only routing can end oracle-equal on two held-out projects while retaining eight transient silent-stale outputs, so end-state equality alone is insufficient; the pinned combined candidate reaches zero silent stale outputs with fail-closed checkpoint recovery on the same challenge. The cross-version opaque recovery refinement adds another narrow boundary: evaluator-source identity drift invalidates stale semantic reuse; changed available source is handled by bounded re-execution, while unavailable source preserves affected outputs as unresolved/escalated instead of fabricating semantics. The donor offline oracle still supplies correctness/hidden-staleness scoring, so none of these State Research refinements promotes general model fidelity beyond seed rung 5. Two materially different real AXM consumers use the exact FAIL/HOLD counterexample packet contract without semantic promotion, earning seed rung 6 only for packet/result consumption. External-consumer continuity checks producer byte identity and distinct registered repositories, not remote runtime deployment. This module grants no execution, merge, promotion, installation, device, network, or CANON authority.
